log: Your leader fell. The company cannot continue without them.
Enemy archer used bow for 2 damage.
Enemy commander used sword for 4 damage.
Enemy heavy infantry used sword for 4 damage and took 3 in retaliation.
Enemy archer used bow for 3 damage and took 3 in retaliation.
An adept and warden arrive from the southern road on turn 6
Your bone archer captured a village.

dialogue.speaker: Orin
dialogue.text: The binding broke at midnight. I waited for another order. None came.

dialogue.speaker: A hollow voice
dialogue.text: Then give us one of our own.

dialogue.speaker: Orin
dialogue.text: We leave the quarry. Keep the archers behind the bones. If the mage finds me, there may not be a second midnight.

dialogue.speaker: The company
dialogue.text: Your leader fell. The company cannot continue without them.

campaign.outcome: Your leader fell. The company cannot continue without them.
